decks.notes: This deck focuses on using a combination of discard spells, removal, and powerful creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to maintain dominance over the battlefield while utilizing strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Etali, Primal Conqueror to close out the game. The deck also includes a mix of utility lands and card draw to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary tools to maintain control and secure victory.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, highly aggressive creatures. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence through cards like Skrelv, Defector Mite and Crawling Chorus, utilizing cards like Tyvar's Stand and Venerated Rotpriest to buff up the creatures and push for damage. Additionally, support cards like Destroy Evil and Annex Sentry provide removal options to clear the way for attacks, while cards like Slaughter Singer and Mirrex offer additional ways to close out games efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through a combination of powerful creatures, enchantments, and spells. By utilizing cards like Reckoner Bankbuster, Leyline Binding, and Archangel of Wrath, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and prevent them from gaining an advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Boseiju, Who Endures allows for additional flexibility and resilience in the face of opposing threats. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and strategic plays to secure victory.

The deck focuses on combining powerful creatures with abilities that enable reanimation, creating a synergistic strategy to overwhelm opponents. It utilizes a mix of removal spells, card draw, and lands that provide the necessary mana fixing. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Corpse Appraiser and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly fill the graveyard and then bring back powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier to dominate the battlefield. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Duress and Negate while steadily building towards its combo win condition.

The main focus of this deck is to heavily control the opponent's board and resources through a combination of removal spells, discard spells, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and generating value from cards like Invoke Despair and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent until it can close out the game with finishers like Light Up the Night and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance. With a mix of removal, disruption, and threats, this Control-Rakdos deck seeks to dominate the game and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful creatures, enchantments, and spells. Its main strategy is to establish board presence with creatures like Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while using cards like Ossification and Leyline Binding to control the opponent's plays. By utilizing the land cards and powerful spells like Invasion of Zendikar, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, disruptive creatures, and powerful finishers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Abrade and Reckoner Bankbuster, while also generating card advantage with Invoke Despair and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck can stabilize the board with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, before closing out the game with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while providing access to a variety of powerful spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful creatures and enchantments that can immobilize and overpower the opponent. By utilizing cards like Archangel of Wrath, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to establish board control and dominate the battlefield. With cards like Topiary Stomper and Ossification to further enhance the deck's control capabilities, the strategy is to outlast the opponent and create an overwhelming advantage to secure victory in the game.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, creatures with powerful effects, and disruption spells to control the game and outvalue opponents. By disrupting their opponent's game plan, removing threats, and generating card advantage, the deck aims to stabilize the board and take over the game with its powerful threats. With a mix of removal, disruption, and powerful creatures, the deck seeks to control the pace of the game and ultimately come out on top through careful resource management and strategic gameplay.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Graveyard Trespasser to maintain card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's game plan with instant speed removal and protective spells. By utilizing synergy between creatures like Valiant Veteran and Skystrike Officer, along with card advantage from Recruitment Officer and Tocasia's Welcome, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient aggression. With a mix of evasion, protection, and disruptive elements, the deck seeks to establish early board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a victory.

This Rakdos Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through targeted removal and hand disruption spells like Duress. It aims to control the board with powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Reckoner Bankbuster, while generating card advantage through cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also includes finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Chandra, Hope's Beacon to close out the game. The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a threatening board presence to secure victory.

This deck focuses on generating a strong board presence and controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of powerful creatures and spells. It emphasizes mana ramping and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and impactful plays. The Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier are key threats that can quickly turn the tide of the game in the player's favor. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Ossification provides additional control elements to handle threats on the opponent's side of the board. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a game of attrition.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful control spells and creatures to dominate the battlefield. By using cards like Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to restrain the opponent's options, while deploying Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to establish a strong board presence. The key strategy lies in managing resources effectively and choosing the right time to deploy threats or disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to maintain control of the game and secure victory through overwhelming force and strategic decision-making.

The key concept of this Grixis Control deck is focused on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption (Duress), removal spells (Go for the Throat, Abrade), and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Reckoner Bankbuster. Additionally, the deck utilizes card advantage and recursion with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Liliana of the Veil to outvalue opponents. The deck aims to control the game by managing threats, disrupting the opponent's plans, and ultimately winning through a combination of efficient removal and powerful threats.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disruption and removal to control the game state, while also utilizing powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to close out the game. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent and grind out wins. By managing threats and resources efficiently, this deck aims to stabilize the board and take over the game in the mid-late game stages. It is essential to play patiently and strategically to maximize the deck's potential.
